title: A dashboard walkthrough
passage:
Would you walk the new engineers through the dashboard?
A. Of course. Is ten o'clock convenient? B. They walked here from the station. C. The new boards arrive tomorrow.
passageZh:
你願意帶新工程師了解儀表板的操作嗎？
A. 當然可以，十點方便嗎？
B. 他們從車站走路過來。
C. 新板子明天到。
